desc:
Wix site management starter sprint is a fixed round of updates, fixes and care for owners who would rather not do the work themselves. Ecom Swift LLC reviews your site, then works through your update list in your own account.

## What is a Wix site management starter sprint?

A starter sprint is a one-time block of site maintenance with a defined scope. We check your site, fix what is broken and then complete a set number of updates: new text and photos, changes to services or products, blog posts, booking settings and form checks. You receive a short summary when it ends.

It is not a monthly plan. If you want us to continue afterward, we quote ongoing care separately, so you always know what you are buying.

## Why does a website need regular hands-on care?

A site goes stale quietly. Prices change, opening hours shift, a staff member leaves, an offer ends and a new service starts. The site keeps showing the old version until someone edits it. Visitors who see outdated information lose trust, and some contact a competitor instead.

Technical drift is just as common. Forms stop reaching an inbox, links break after a page is renamed, images grow heavy and apps stay installed long after anyone used them. Small tasks wait while the owner runs the business, and the list grows. A sprint clears that list in one pass.

## How updates affect enquiries and visitor trust

Fresh, accurate pages answer visitor questions at the moment they ask them. A booking page with correct service details prevents confused emails. A blog post or event listing shows the business is active and gives search engines new content to index. Resized images help pages load more quickly on phones.

Regular upkeep also protects the leads you already receive. When forms and links are tested, a contact attempt does not vanish. We cannot promise more traffic or sales from maintenance alone, since that depends on your market, but an accurate, working site is a requirement for any other marketing to pay off.

## What a good management sprint includes

- A site check that lists broken links, forms and settings, with a fix for each.
- A restore point saved in your site history before any editing starts.
- Content updates to text, photos, prices and contact details.
- Service, booking or product changes entered correctly.
- Blog posts, events or product entries published with proper titles.
- Forms and links tested with real submissions.
- Images resized so pages stay quick to load.
- Small layout fixes for spacing, alignment and mobile display.
- Page titles reviewed on key pages.
- A short summary of what changed and a suggested plan for the next round.

## How we work

You send your update list by email or message, with new text, images and instructions attached. We sort it, count the items against your package and confirm anything unclear before starting. Then we work through the list in your editor, test the result and publish once you approve.

The Basic package covers a site check and a short list of updates. The Standard package handles a longer list with blog posts or events, booking details and image cleanup. The Premium package is a full sprint that adds small design improvements, a review of page titles and a check of your apps and Wix plan. Extra updates and speed cleanups can be added.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Send updates in one batch rather than a trickle.
- Write the exact text and attach final images.
- Mark urgent items so we do them first.
- Keep your own login private and use collaborator access.
- Tell us about changes planned for next month.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for a redesign inside a maintenance list.
- Sending placeholder text that needs rewriting.
- Editing the same pages at the same time as us.
- Expecting order handling or customer service to be included.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A small business owner with a long list of overdue site changes.
- A restaurant, salon or studio with changing hours, menus or service lists.
- A professional who inherited a site and wants a clean starting point before deciding on regular care.
- A shop owner who needs product and page updates but not order management.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, the list of updates with final text and images, and add us as a collaborator or team member in your Wix account. We never need your password. Tell us which pages matter most so we can focus there first. After the sprint you get a plain summary, and you decide whether to continue.
